description: Perform a complete DHIS2 system health audit. Log in to DHIS2 (admin/district) and navigate to the Data Administration app. (1) Trigger the 'Analytics tables' generation (or Resource Tables) to refresh the system cache. (2) Run the 'Data Integrity' checks to scan for metadata issues. (3) Create a text report at '/home/ga/Desktop/system_health_report.txt' documenting: the DHIS2 system version, whether analytics were triggered successfully, and a summary of any data integrity violations found (or stating if none were found). The report must be saved to the Desktop.
